Body.Content:
Associates can trigger the Bulk add operation from the button grid on the transaction screen in Store Commerce. A drawer-based dialog opens where associates can paste or enter multiple item number and quantity pairs, with one pair specified per line.

Supported formats include SKU x quantity, quantity x SKU, SKU quantity, quantity SKU, or SKU only (which defaults the quantity to 1).

Multiple item number and quantity pairs can also be entered on a single line and separated by spaces or commas.

Supported delimiters between item numbers and quantities include x, spaces, commas, and tab characters for Microsoft Excel paste scenarios. Input can also follow a CSV structure.

Select Add to sale to process all items in a single operation.

The system parses the input, resolves each item, and adds the items to the transaction. If an item requires variant selection, such as size or color, the variant selection dialog is displayed inline.

Feedback and error handling

Success: The dialog closes and a confirmation message indicates that all items were added successfully.

Partial success: A warning message shows the number of items that were added and the number that failed. Failed items remain in the dialog so they can be corrected and resubmitted.

Failure: An error message is displayed. The dialog remains open and includes a collapsible error list that identifies the items that failed and the reason for each failure.

Duplicate item numbers aren't merged and remain as separate transaction lines.

Entry point

The operation is accessed through the button grid, allowing merchants to add it to any button grid layout by using the existing screen layout designer.

Configuration

Application: Store Commerce (Point of Sale)

Enabled by: Adding the Bulk add operation to a button grid through the screen layout designer in Commerce headquarters.

Setup: A store administrator or IT administrator configures a button grid layout to include the Bulk add operation. After the configuration is published, associates can access the operation from the transaction screen.

GA date: September CY2026

Preview date: July CY2026
